caption: The drawing depicts a vertical black rod or shaft that passes through several attached objects. Near the top of the rod, there is a brown, four-bladed pinwheel or vane. Below this, towards the middle of the composition, there is a decorative horizontal vane colored in shades of brown and gold, with a detailed, ornate design on the left and a fan-shaped, ribbed extension on the right. Further down the rod, there is an oval-shaped brown object encircling the rod, with gradations of shading suggesting rounded form. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset sketch showing a scaled, technical outline of the same assembly with measurements, drawn in pencil without color. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Weather Vane
